_source: https://api.minascan.io/node/devnet/v1/graphql (Mina DEVNET public node), GraphQL bestChain(maxLength:5){ stateHash protocolStateProof { base64 } protocolState { previousStateHash consensusState { blockHeight } } }
_why: FIVE CONSECUTIVE devnet blocks, each with its OWN protocolStateProof. The single-block fixture (mina_devnet_block.json) cannot exhibit the proof->proof chain: block N proof names block N-1 proof, and one block has no parent proof to name. Provenance note: protocolStateProof is a GraphQL OBJECT with a base64 subfield, NOT a scalar - selecting it bare returns {}.
